summary: Texxon Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held on May 22, 2026. Shareholders approved routine re-election of directors, adoption of a 2026 equity incentive plan, ratification of auditor ZH CPA, LLC, and authorized a potential share split (up to 1:5) and consolidation (up to 20:1) at board discretion within one year. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign occurred; the proposed capital structure changes are ordinary resolutions with board discretion to implement or not. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of AGM outcomes with no deal terms or strategic transformation.
